records: The gitignored generated apps/docs/src/data/registry-items.json is absent in a fresh worktree and gates pnpm typecheck — copy or regenerate it via pnpm registry:build inside the worktree; never commit it.

The NativeWind marathon tokens are 75-minute-class each and may legally double through runDriverWithKillRetry's one external-kill retry; the harness's per-child timeouts must respect the full envelope, and the reserved device selectors (RNR_S05_IOS_UDID, RNR_S05_ANDROID_SERIAL) must be live before the run.

The aggregate rerun uses a stable TMPDIR outside the agent-session scratch (~/.cache/agent-scratch) and records the TMPDIR policy in run.json — the reaper cascade countermeasure.
Single-instance discipline: never run two drills sharing a consumer cache concurrently (the recorded duplicate-RED race lesson); the FUSE-01 build lock serializes the build-chain lanes.
